reviews.name: Gayathri Diwakar
reviews.pull: My engagement, muhurtham and reception looks were all beyond my expectations.
reviews.full: My journey with Menan Makeovers started with my engagement, my first makeover. Aishu sis made me look so beautiful and the makeup was flawless; even my husband was surprised to see this version of me. From that day onwards she has done my makeover for every occasion: my marriage, reception, baby shower, pre-wedding shoot, maternity shoot and even my son's first birthday. She gave a natural and elegant look on all occasions; the engagement, muhurtham and reception looks were beyond my expectations. Her team made me so comfortable, they were always on time, and I strongly recommend her to everyone.

reviews.name: Vino Dhini
reviews.pull: The base felt incredibly lightweight but easily survived the long rituals and heavy garlands without creasing.
reviews.full: Absolutely phenomenal experience with my wedding and reception makeup! For the morning ceremony, she gave me a classic, flawless traditional South Indian bridal look that perfectly complemented my red silk saree and temple jewellery. The base felt incredibly lightweight but easily survived the long rituals and heavy garlands without creasing. For the evening reception, she completely transformed my vibe into a stunning modern glam look to go with my champagne lehenga. The switch from the traditional braid to a chic soft updo was seamless, and the makeup was incredibly radiant under the bright stage spotlights. She is incredibly professional, highly punctual, listens to exactly what you want, and makes sure your saree draping and jewellery are completely secure. If you want a stress-free, versatile bridal makeup artist who can master both classic and modern looks, look no further. Highly, highly recommended!

reviews.name: Dr. Sandhiya P
reviews.pull: Subtle, elegant and natural. Exactly how I wanted it.
reviews.full: I chose Menan Makeovers for my baby shower makeup and I am extremely happy with the result. The look was subtle, elegant and natural, exactly how I wanted it. The base makeup was flawless, comfortable and long lasting. Highly recommended for brides and moms-to-be. Thank you for making my day special.

reviews.name: Medini R
reviews.pull: They handled five people at once, from hairstyling and makeup to saree draping, with flawless coordination.
reviews.full: I booked my wedding makeover with Menan Makeovers for both my reception and wedding, and it was truly a wonderful experience! From start to finish, everything was handled professionally and with such a friendly attitude. The entire team was full of smiling faces, which really helped ease the nerves on such big days. Not only was my bridal makeover done to perfection, but the groom's makeover and the bridesmaids' styling were also handled with complete satisfaction. One major highlight is their punctuality and time management. They handled five people at once, from hairstyling and makeup to saree draping, and everything was done top to bottom with flawless coordination. Thank you so much to the entire team!

reviews.name: Sushmidha K
reviews.pull: Whatever reference or preference I shared, they executed it perfectly.
reviews.full: Menan Makeovers, Pondicherry, is a wonderful makeup team. I chose them for my pre-wedding shoot and I'm extremely happy with the results. The look was very subtle and elegant, exactly how I wanted it. Whatever reference or preference I shared, they executed it perfectly. The base makeup was flawless, felt super comfortable and looked amazing on me. They patiently listened to every small request and delivered exactly what I envisioned. Honestly, this felt like the best version of me. I truly appreciate their patience, professionalism and punctuality; everything was done on time without any rush. On top of that, their pricing is very affordable for the quality they provide. I would highly recommend Menan Makeovers to all brides-to-be: trust them and let them work their magic!

reviews.name: Amala C
reviews.pull: One of the finest makeup artists in Pondy. Both makeup and hairdo were picture perfect.
reviews.full: One of the finest makeup artists in Pondy. I booked them for my engagement and wedding as well. Both makeup and hairdo were picture perfect. I had asked for a soft, subtle glam for my wedding and they brought it out exactly. Great work!

reviews.name: Jaya Vani
reviews.pull: My makeup lasted from 4:30 am until 6 pm, and I received so many compliments.
reviews.full: I would like to extend my heartfelt thanks for your exceptional service in getting me ready for both my reception and wedding. Despite the limited time, you accommodated all my requests and made sure every detail of the look changeover was exactly how I envisioned it. Your saree draping was so comfortable that I didn't even feel like I was wearing one. I am especially grateful for your dedication during the reception makeover, getting me ready beautifully in just one hour with such calmness and patience. Overall, I am extremely happy with your service. My makeup lasted from 4:30 am until 6 pm, and I received so many compliments from friends and family. Thank you once again for your excellent work and professionalism.

reviews.name: Parveen
reviews.pull: Loved my look, and it exactly matched what I asked for.
reviews.full: I had a really wonderful experience with my Nikkah makeover. They were really patient and on time. Loved my look, and it exactly matched what I asked for. Thanks a lot for the service and the experience. I would definitely recommend this place.

reviews.name: S. Leka Lakshmi Priya
reviews.pull: I was a little nervous, but Menan Makeovers made me feel so comfortable and beautiful.
reviews.full: I absolutely loved their work! The hairdo was just perfect and exactly what I wanted. This was my first time getting professional makeup done, so I was a little nervous and scared, but Menan Makeovers truly made my day and made me feel so comfortable and beautiful. The makeup was flawless, elegant and long-lasting throughout the event. I received so many compliments, and I couldn't have been happier with the final look. Thank you so much for making my special day even more beautiful and memorable! I highly recommend your work!

reviews.name: Swetha S
reviews.pull: The drape, hairdo, everything was perfect and on time.
reviews.full: Menan Makeovers did my sister's engagement, and now we have booked them for her wedding too. We are extremely satisfied with the professionalism they showed throughout. The look we expected was delivered. The drape, hairdo, everything was perfect and on time. They were very friendly and genuine, and made us feel so comfortable. Thank you so much! Looking forward to my sister's big day with Menan Makeovers too.

founder.name: Aishwarya
founder.bio: Aishwarya started Menan Makeovers as a freelance artist with a single chair and a mirror in a small room at home. After training under mentors across Tamil Nadu, she built a studio and a team of women where a bride finds every service she needs under one roof.
